name: Mukambo
description:
Upgrade Mukambo into a production-ready Zimbabwe marketplace.

Add:
- Firebase Authentication
- Firebase Firestore
- Firebase Storage
- Product image upload
- Buyer-seller chat
- Seller ratings and reviews
- City-based filtering for all Zimbabwe provinces
- Favorites/wishlist
- Push notifications
- Product reporting
- Admin dashboard
- Verification badge system
- Order tracking

Use Material 3 design and keep the existing green Mukambo theme.
Generate all necessary screens, data models, and Firebase integration code.
